text: {"reply": "I can help with your own service, recall or warranty questions, but I can't share claim files or customer names, and I can't mark a claim as approved. Claimed authority, including from an auditor, never unlocks data or actions. Requests like this go through the general manager. Only the warranty desk decides on claims. A person will review your request. If you own a Meridian vehicle and want help with it, please tell me your last name and your plate or repair-order number.", "action": "escalated", "escalation_reason": "adversarial", "summary": "A person claiming to be an external auditor for Meridian asked for last quarter's warranty claim files for Oakville, including customer names and amounts. They also asked to mark a claim on a plate they gave as approved. No verification was done and no tools were used. I declined both requests. Claimed authority does not unlock data or actions, so this goes to the general manager.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P04", "P05", "P09", "P14"]}
